svg.title: A - Light metallic arm: static design prototype
svg.desc: 920 by 720 synthetic discussion context. A 420 pixel glass action dial, nine positions of which one is concealed beneath a stationary upper-left separator. This is not a browser verification screenshot.

g.text: new | past | comments | ask | show | jobs
The surprising longevity of simple software
I think this is mostly about minimizing scope. The things that survive a decade
are usually the ones that do a few things well.
Agree. Every time I have seen a project grow without a clear stopping point,
it just accretes features until nobody understands how it works.
There is also something to be said for leaving working systems alone.
Complexity so often becomes a maintenance cost.
Yep. Boring tech in a good way tends to stay boring in a good way.
A simple tool that is easy to understand has a very long life.
A question worth asking: what can we remove?
Sometimes the best thing to build is the smallest useful version.
A - Light metallic arm. Static prototype, not browser evidence.
